prompt: An aromatic compound with molecular formula C7H8 shows the IR spectrum below. Which compound is it?
explanation: Toluene: aromatic C=C around 1600/1500, aromatic C–H above 3000 cm⁻¹, sp³ C–H just below 3000, no C=O (rules out acetophenone/benzoic acid), no O–H (rules out phenol/benzoic acid).
